pps_device.description: PPS device file (e.g., /dev/pps0) connected to the kernel PPS API.

pps_offset.description: Offset (in seconds) to apply to the PPS signal, typically for cable length or hardware delays.

pps_flag1.description: PPS flag bits (0 or 1). Set to 1 if the PPS signal is active on the rising edge.

hostname.description: Hostname or IP of the NTP server.

prefer.description: Mark this server as preferred (iburst prefer).

key_id.description: Authentication key ID (null if no auth needed).

ntp_servers.description: List of NTP servers used for fallback and initial synchronization. At least one is recommended.

enable_ntp_auth.description: Enable NTP server authentication (requires trusted keys).

secret.description: MD5 secret (no spaces or special characters).

ntp_auth_keys.description: List of NTP authentication keys. Required only if enable_ntp_auth is true.

ntp_trusted_keys.description: List of key IDs trusted for NTP authentication (must match entries in ntp_auth_keys).

drift_file.description: Path to the file storing the RTC drift compensation.

rtc_file.description: Path to the file tracking RTC adjustments.

init_stepslew_threshold.description: Maximum offset (in seconds) for initial step slew during startup. Larger offsets cause step instead of slew.

makestep_threshold.description: Maximum offset (in seconds) allowed before chronyd steps the clock (instead of slewing).

makestep_burst_limit.description: Maximum number of steps allowed within makestep_threshold before chronyd refuses to step further.

rtcalibration_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between RTC calibration measurements (0 = disable).

allow_ntp_clients.description: List of networks or hosts allowed to query this chrony instance (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24'). Empty = localhost-only.

hwtimestamp_interfaces.description: List of network interfaces for hardware timestamping. Empty or ['all'] enables for all interfaces.
